source: Mack, T. (1993). Distribution-free calculation of the standard error of chain ladder reserve estimates. ASTIN Bulletin 23(2), 213-225. Section 4, Tables 1-3. PDF: https://www.casact.org/sites/default/files/database/astin_vol23no2_213.pdf (fetched 2026-08-23, 456894 bytes, 14 pages).
data: Taylor and Ashe (1983) run-off triangle, cumulative, 10 accident years x 10 development years; see taylor_ashe_cumulative.csv (transcribed from Table 1 via pdftotext; verify against the PDF before citing).
sigma_row_note: Mack's printed row is sigma_k^2 / 1000 (pdftotext renders the exponent as a stray character). First transcription of this file labelled it sigma_k / 1000; the reproduction script caught the factor. Same slip class as the Wuthrich-Merz 2009 corrections list.
sigma_9_note: Mack sets sigma_9^2 = min(sigma_8^4/sigma_7^2, min(sigma_7^2, sigma_8^2)) by extrapolation; this is a convention, not an estimator, and is one of the items in the variant catalogue.
reproduction_targets: The verified estimators must reproduce the reserves column exactly (to rounding in thousands) and the s.e. percentages to the printed precision. Any discrepancy is a finding, not an error to hide.
